第73章 老首长-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》

一九七一年一月，北疆的寒风还卷着边防线上的霜雪，北京城里的树枝光秃秃的，被风吹得呜呜响。

团里的周副团长，早年在边境作战时肺部中弹，弹片嵌在肺叶里，辗转多家医院，都因位置凶险、手术风险极高，始终无法取出。常年的咳痰、胸闷、咯血折磨着他，稍一劳累便喘不上气，身体日渐衰弱。西医穷尽手段也只能勉强缓解，根本无法根治。

王建新在边防团的时候，就用针灸和中药帮周副团长把弹片咳了出来。当时治了一个星期，最后一天晚上，周副团长猛地一阵咳嗽，一块小弹片混着浓痰咳了出来，胸口积压多年的沉闷感瞬间消失。

不过一月，周副团长肺部积压十几年的顽疾彻底痊愈，呼吸顺畅、精神抖擻，完全恢复了正常人的身体。以前走几步就喘，现在能跑能跳，跟换了个人似的。

无独有偶，周副团长远在京城的一位德高望重的老首长，早年征战沙场时，同样落下了肺部弹片残留的旧疾，病症比周副团长还要严重。几十年间，京城各大医院的顶尖专家、专属保健医生轮番诊治，会诊无数次，都摇头束手无策——弹片毗邻要害血管，稍有不慎就会引发大出血，危及生命，只能靠药物保守治疗。老首长常年被病痛缠身，身体每况愈下，近日连日常活动都备受限制，走几步路就喘得不行，夜里经常咳醒，咳出来的痰里带着血丝。

周副团长痊愈后，偶然从老首长身边人口中得知这一情况，心中瞬间燃起希望。他深知王建新的医术早已超越世间所有名医——一个能把肺里弹片用针灸和中药逼出来的人，还有什么病治不了？

而此时的王建新，进入北京医学院不过四个多月，却早已在校园乃至周边医院一鸣惊人。他接连独立完成多台高难度手术——胃大部分切除、针麻阑尾切除、断指再植、颅内占位病变开颅——每一台都堪称完美，无一例外全部成功。学校的老师、医院的医生都惊为天人，直呼天才。

周副团长一刻也不敢耽搁。他立刻动身赶往北京医学院，没提前打招呼，直接到了学校门口，让门卫通报。

王建新正在实验室里钻研医术。张教授给他安排了一间小实验室，里面摆着显微镜、切片机、各种试剂，他没事就泡在里面，看片子、做实验、读文献。门卫跑来喊他，说有人找。他放下手里的切片，擦了擦手，出了实验室。

走到校门口，看见周副团长站在寒风里，穿着一件旧军大衣，脸冻得通红。

“首长？”王建新快步走过去，立正敬礼，“您怎么来了？”

周副团长一把抓住他的手，没松。他的眼睛里有光，有急切，也有恳求。

“建新，你救了我这条命，我这辈子都忘不了！”他的声音有点发颤，“现在有位为国征战一生的老首长，跟我当年一样，肺里嵌着几十年的弹片。京城所有专家都治不好，我思来想去，只有你能救他！你跟我去看看，哪怕只有一丝希望，也求求你试一试！”

王建新看着周副团长的眼睛，没说话。

他明白此事非同小可。一九七一年的京城，等级森严，老首长身份尊贵，身边环绕的都是国内最顶尖的医学权威。自己不过是个刚入学的工农兵学员，连正式医生都算不上，贸然出手，必定引来轩然大波。治好了还好说，万一出了差错——不，他不会出差错。他身怀修仙功法与宗师中医传承，治疗这等病症有着百分百的把握。

但转念一想，若自己只是个普通医生，没有这份逆天依仗，一旦出手失败，老首长出现意外，自己这辈子彻底毁了不说，家人也必定会受到牵连，下场不堪设想。他一个人担得起，但家里人担不起。

他沉默了好一会儿。周副团长站在他面前，没有催他，就那么等着，眼睛里全是恳切。

王建新想起老首长为国家立下的汗马功劳，想起那些从战场上带回来的弹片，想起周副团长肺里那块折磨了他十几年的东西。他点了头。

“好，我去看看。”

周副团长眼眶一红，用力拍了拍他的肩膀，没说出话来。

In January 1971, the cold wind in northern Xinjiang was still carrying frost and snow on the border defense line. The branches in Beijing were bare and whined by the wind.

The deputy commander of the regiment, Zhou, was shot in the lung while fighting on the border in his early years. The shrapnel was embedded in the lung lobe. He was sent to many hospitals, but due to the dangerous location and extremely high surgical risks, he could not be removed.He suffered from coughing up phlegm, chest tightness, and hemoptysis all year round. He could not breathe at the slightest exertion, and his body became increasingly weak.Western medicine has tried its best to provide relief, but cannot cure it at all.

When Wang Jianxin was in the border defense regiment, he used acupuncture and traditional Chinese medicine to help Deputy Commander Zhou cough out the shrapnel.After a week of treatment, on the last night, Deputy Commander Zhou suddenly coughed and coughed up a small piece of shrapnel mixed with thick phlegm. The dull feeling in his chest that had accumulated for many years disappeared instantly.

However, in January, Vice Captain Zhou completely recovered from the stubborn lung disease that had been accumulated for more than ten years. He breathed smoothly, was energetic, and completely returned to a normal body.I used to be out of breath after walking a few steps, but now I can run and jump, as if I was a different person.

Coincidentally, Deputy Commander Zhou, a respected old leader in the capital, also suffered from an old disease caused by shrapnel in his lungs when he was fighting in the battlefield in his early years. His illness was even more severe than that of Deputy Commander Zhou.For decades, top experts and exclusive health doctors from major hospitals in the capital took turns to diagnose and treat the patient. After countless consultations, they all shook their heads and were helpless - the shrapnel was adjacent to the vital blood vessels, and a slight mistake would cause massive bleeding, which was life-threatening. The only conservative treatment was with drugs.The old leader has been plagued by illness all year round, and his health is deteriorating. Recently, even his daily activities have been restricted. He can't breathe even after walking a few steps. He often wakes up coughing at night, and the phlegm he coughs up is blood-streaked.

After Deputy Captain Zhou recovered, he accidentally learned about this situation from someone close to the old leader, and hope instantly ignited in his heart.He knew that Wang Jianxin's medical skills had already surpassed all the famous doctors in the world - for a man who could force the shrapnel out of his lungs with acupuncture and Chinese medicine, what other diseases could he not cure?

At this time, Wang Jianxin had only been admitted to Beijing Medical College for more than four months, but he had already made a name for himself on campus and even in surrounding hospitals.He independently completed multiple difficult surgeries one after another - subtotal gastrectomy, appendectomy under needle anesthesia, replantation of severed fingers, and craniotomy for intracranial space-occupying lesions - each one was perfect and all were successful without exception.Teachers at the school and doctors at the hospital were all shocked and called him a genius.

Deputy Captain Zhou did not dare to delay for a moment.He immediately set off for Beijing Medical College. Without saying hello in advance, he went directly to the school gate and asked the guard to inform him.

Wang Jianxin is studying medical skills in the laboratory.Professor Zhang arranged a small laboratory for him, which was equipped with a microscope, a microtome, and various reagents. He stayed in it whenever he had nothing to do, watching films, doing experiments, and reading literature.The guard came and called him, saying that someone was looking for him.He put down the slices in his hand, wiped his hands, and left the laboratory.

When I walked to the school gate, I saw Deputy Commander Zhou standing in the cold wind, wearing an old army coat, his face red from the cold.

"Chief?" Wang Jianxin walked over quickly, stood at attention and saluted, "Why are you here?"

Deputy Captain Zhou grabbed his hand and didn't let go.There was light in his eyes, eagerness, and pleading.

"Jianxin, you saved my life. I will never forget it in my life!" His voice was trembling. "Now there is an old leader who has fought for the country all his life. Just like me, he has decades of shrapnel embedded in his lungs. All the experts in the capital can't cure him. After thinking about it, only you can save him! Come with me to see if there is even a glimmer of hope. Please give it a try!"

Wang Jianxin looked into Deputy Leader Zhou's eyes and said nothing.

He understood that this matter was not trivial.In the capital city of 1971, there was a strict hierarchy. The old chief had a distinguished status and was surrounded by the top medical authorities in the country.He is just a worker, peasant, and soldier student who has just entered school, and he is not even a formal doctor. If he takes action rashly, he will definitely cause an uproar.It's okay to say that it's cured, but if something goes wrong - no, he won't go wrong.With his immortality cultivation techniques and master's traditional Chinese medicine inheritance, he is 100% sure of treating such diseases.

But then I thought about it, if I was just an ordinary doctor without this kind of support, if the attack failed and the old leader had an accident, my life would be completely ruined, my family would also be implicated, and the end would be unimaginable.He can afford it alone, but his family cannot.

He was silent for a while.Deputy Captain Zhou stood in front of him, not urging him, just waiting, his eyes full of sincerity.

Wang Jianxin thought of the old leader's great contribution to the country, the shrapnel brought back from the battlefield, and the thing in Deputy Commander Zhou's lungs that had tortured him for more than ten years.He nodded.

"Okay, I'll go take a look."

Vice Captain Zhou's eyes turned red and he patted his shoulder hard without saying a word.
